notes.title: Race of Life Act 1 – Now in Latin American Spanish and French! 🎉
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/bf680f0189e24677f42ddfafa3b2bc8a8f5bdc36.png"][/img][b]Race of Life Act 1 – Now in Latin American Spanish and French![/b] 🎉
[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that Race of Life Act 1 is now available in [b]Latin American Spanish[/b] and [b]French[/b]! We know you’ve been waiting for these languages for a while, but thanks to the amazing work of our translators, they are finally here. We’re eternally grateful for their dedication! ❤️
[/p][p]Additionally, our incredible [b]Italian[/b] translator has completed the [b]walkthrough in Italian[/b], so all of you who wanted it can now enjoy it in your language. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3443210/Race_of_Life_Act_1__Official_Walkthrough/"][/dynamiclink]It’s been a while since our last status update, but that’s only because we’ve been pouring all our energy into the next part of the game - Race of Life Act 2. Just like Act 1 (or maybe even more), this one is going to be packed with excitement, drama, and of course… lots of fun with our sexy girls. 😉 Act 2 will be released when Episodes 4, 5, and 6 are complete. To keep you from waiting empty-handed, we’ve included a few previews from Act 2 – just a little taste to get you in the mood for what’s coming next. 💋  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/2e50ed79681a8944d32ab34cccc10df70e05dcd0.png"][/img][/p][p]Right now, we’re already close to finishing Episode 4 and trust us, a lot happens there. Expect plenty of [b]NSFW scenes[/b], spicy moments, new racing scenes and new experiences with your favorite girls. 🔥 I've also been experimenting with new animation techniques to make the action even better and hotter. I can’t wait to see what you think.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/d834d9543977fa5dd417930d16aba30ab2125042.png"][/img][/p][p]We always try to plan each Episode in a way that every main love interest gets her fair share of satisfying content, while still keeping the story of Race of Life moving forward. Every main character has her spotlight, but you’ll also meet some irresistible side chicks who will spice things up even more. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/6db17fa957a2ee07239860f03b0f646eacf09525.png"][/img][/p][p]Right now, we already have over [b]2,000 renders and dozens of animations ready for Act 2[/b] and we’re not stopping there. Expect even more spicy moments, smooth animations, and gorgeous visuals that will make every scene come alive. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/674d6864f94c046844873814e8cf12a610a86a32.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re also working on the new Steam page for Act 2, so you’ll be able to wishlist it as soon as it’s live. Once it’s ready, we’ll let you know right away – so stay tuned!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/b38c0164e0cc59cfcb989f7443ec2ec0ac4deb91.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/9ee99750e65696d911c682c9ae4c6a8f2416c681.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/7fe3e0c832d2cc7cc3374a361e18a05c86cdbb9e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

Wishing you all the best this Easter from our cute [i]Race of Life bunnies[/i]! 🥚💐 To celebrate, they’ve brought you a little something special in their basket — [b]a -35% discount on the game![/b] 🎁 [b]The promotion will run from April 18 to April 27[/b], so if you haven’t had the chance to play Race of Life Act 1 yet, now’s the perfect time to hop in! 🐇✨

notes.title: Race of Life Act 1 - hotfix v1.04.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just fixed an issue that was affecting access to saves made before the last hotfix. The good news is: your pre-update saves [b]SHOULD[/b] now work again! 🎉If we didn't f*ck something up in the process, that is.

[b]However, we also want to be honest with you — this fix may have caused some saves made after April 10th (in specific scenes) to no longer function correctly. We’re really sorry about that. 😔[/b]

Over the past few days, we’ve been working hard to understand and solve this issue. Unfortunately, it was something out of our control — it’s a rare problem that can occur with the engine we use to build the game. This was our first time encountering it too.

We truly hope this won't happen in future updates, but we can’t promise it won’t — though we’ll do everything we can to prevent it.

Also, good news: we might have fixed the issue where the walkthrough wasn’t launching properly. If you had trouble with that before, please give it another try after this update and let us know if it works for you!

We're really sorry for the inconvenience, and we hope those of you who started new saves recently will understand the situation. [b]If you need to replay the game from the beginning, take use of the skip function. You can also turn on "Skip the unseen" option in settings - it'll speed up the process even more.[/b]

Thanks so much for your support and patience!

notes.title: Race of Life Act 1 now available in Italian!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/50cd822800a17f6a11ce7091cc7bf48c4b1234f5.png[/img]

Mamma mia! Maggie just zipped through the narrow streets of an Italian village on her scooter, dodging flower pots and stray cats — all to deliver you some piping hot news!

[b]Race of Life Act I is now fully playable in Italian![/b]

We’re thrilled to finally share the game with our Italian-speaking community — and it’s all thanks to one amazing beta tester who went above and beyond by translating the entire first act on his own. We can’t thank him enough. 🙌 Grazie mille! ❤️

Additional language support is still in progress. Given the size and complexity of the game, it’s a time-consuming process — but rest assured, we're fully committed to making it happen.

Thank you so much for all the support, the kind words, and the love you’ve shown Race of Life so far.
[b]We’re hard at work on Act II — but more on that soon![/b] 😉

notes.title: Wallpaper Collection is now available!
notes.notes:
The [b]Wallpaper Collection[/b] is now available on Steam! You can now choose from as many as 50 wallpapers for your computer! Wallpapers featuring [b]Jasmine[/b], [b]Allison[/b], [b]Maggie[/b], [b]Natalya[/b], [b]Alexa[/b], [b]Veronica[/b], and more are waiting for you! You can find this little add-on here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3436070/Race_of_Life_Act_1__Wallpaper_Collection/

Work on the language updates is still ongoing! As soon as the next language is ready for release, we’ll let you know!

notes.title: Russian language and Official Walkthrough now available!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce the release of the [b]Race of Life Act 1 Walkthrough[/b]! This highly detailed guide will help you win races, unlock all achievements, and discover every possible game path. It’s available now, and you can grab it to uncover all the secrets of Race of Life! For those who haven’t yet decided to play the game, the walkthrough is also available as part of a bundle with the game itself.

At the moment, the walkthrough is only available in English (it’s 160 pages long, so translating it is a significant effort for our team), but we plan to update it with other language versions in the future.

Another fantastic piece of news is that the Russian language version is ready! The game has been updated to include this language, and you can now play [b]Race of Life Act 1[/b] in Russian! So, if you’ve been holding off on trying the game due to the lack of this language, we warmly encourage you to jump in now. 😊

notes.title: Race of Life Act 1 - hotfix 1.01
notes.notes: I uploaded a simple hotfix that fixes some typos and a few bugs in Chinese version, mainly game crash in the parking lot scene with Veronica.

notes.title: We fixed the prices!
notes.notes:
[b]We fixed the prices![/b]

Unfortunately, some countries had the wrong, overly high prices set, and we want to sincerely apologize for that! We've corrected these prices now, and we hope you won't face any more issues.

This is entirely on us – converting the prices a few months ago during high inflation was definitely a poor decision, especially since we didn't update them afterward. We're truly sorry and hope this hasn't discouraged you from giving Race of Life Act 1 a chance!

notes.title: Race of Life is Now Live on Steam! 🏁🎮
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/bec148d29bba22f7b3012e440de3ac6d57ae08f9.png[/img]

[h3]We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Race of Life Act 1[/i] is officially [b]live on Steam[/b] and ready for you to play! [/h3]
While we’ve thoroughly tested the game, with so many possible paths, there’s always a chance you might encounter a bug. If you do, please don’t hesitate to let us know – we’ll do our best to address any issues as quickly as possible. 🛠️

[b]For our Russian-speaking players:[/b] the Russian translation is finished and currently in testing. As soon as it’s 100% playable, we’ll release an update for the game. We hope this happens as soon as possible, and we deeply apologize for not being able to include it at launch. Thank you for your patience!

We also have plans for two simple DLCs coming soon!
1️⃣[i] A walkthrough guide[/i] (PDF) to help you explore all the different ways to play the game.
2️⃣[i] A wallpaper pack[/i] featuring 50 stunning wallpapers of the characters from the game.
These weren’t ready in time for launch, but they’ll be available as soon as Steam gives us the green light. 🎉

Enjoy the game and good luck on the track! 🏎️💨

notes.title: Release is Just Around the Corner! 🎉
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/94e9c596f5b06d9e8b9da107935f595832461d9d.png[/img]

We're down to just a few days until launch, and we're putting the final touches on everything! We're excited to announce that we've added the last batch of achievements—[b]there will be 56 for you to unlock[/b]! 🏆✨

Unfortunately, we had to temporarily remove support for some languages. But don't worry—they’re not gone forever! We're in the final stages of translating the last episode into additional languages, and the sheer volume of text has been a massive challenge for our translators.

To avoid delaying the launch further, we've decided to release the game with [b]Polish[/b], [b]Turkish[/b] and [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] fully supported at launch. We're actively working on [b]Russian[/b], which will likely come shortly after release. We're also making great progress on [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]French[/b], and [b]Italian[/b], with plans to include them as soon as possible post-launch.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your patience and support as we work to bring the game to as many players as possible! ❤️

Mark your calendars—[b]January 10th[/b] is the day, and we can't wait to share this adventure with you! 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/a06b804843d05f98e674cd25c05146e2370b19be.png[/img]

notes.title: Official Release Date for Race of Life: Act I - January 10, 2025!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]🚨 [b]Official Release Date for Race of Life: Act I - January 10, 2025![/b] 🚨[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/1721c8b70ae2665f927096cf1ea29beba0ddf06d.png[/img]

🎉 After countless hours of designing, rendering, and testing, we're thrilled to announce that Race of Life: Act I will officially launch on January 10, 2025! 🎮

📅 We know the game was originally planned for a 2024 release, but we wanted to avoid the busy holiday season 🎄✨ with Christmas and New Year’s Eve🎆. After careful consideration, we decided that early January is the perfect time to kick things off! 🚀

🙏 We sincerely apologize for the delay. Unfortunately, delays are a common challenge in indie game development, as we often underestimate the time required to bring our vision to life. That said, we’re incredibly proud of what we’ve created! 

Here’s what awaits you:
🔥 8-12 hours of gameplay
📸 Over 11,000 images
🎥 Over 500 animations
🚗 Animated racing scenes - make the right choices and win!
❤️‍🔥 25 lewd scenes with various women and 4 Extra Scenes we hope you’ll fall in love with

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/45efe7530fc8ec43377bf1b4b5e019a994aa06a3.jpg[/img]

The content is packed because Jake’s life is as intense as it gets! 🌟 Buckle up for the ride of a lifetime. 🚗💨
Leading up to the release, we’ll introduce you to more characters 👥, let you get to know them better, and set the mood for Race of Life. 🏁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/95ea26f76186b680284a59afb3b7e2de1f218ea6.jpg[/img]

💖 Thank you for your patience and support—it means the world to us. 🌍 See you at the starting line on January 10th! 🏎️✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/bbe0a636f51df9a871141440ebad34234375635f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Who’s Allison?
notes.notes:
Are you ready to meet Jake’s ex-wife? Will you be able to win over this petite blonde after Jake broke her heart with his foolish mistakes? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/be0eb2fb7ec50c976faf630f5f6b7106a437bc0a.jpg[/img]

But old wounds don’t heal easily—so is Jake ready to mend this relationship, or does he prefer to continue living his new, adventurous, and wildly diverse romantic life? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/85fbe1e4b2dc692a819f2db9920d9d4a2242923d.jpg[/img]
No matter what choices you make, she’ll be a frequent presence—after all, she’s the mother of their daughter... So be careful with your relationship with this tempting blonde!

notes.title: Development news 11.06.2024. Meet Veronica!
notes.notes:
We've got over 10 hours of gameplay ready for you, with nearly 8,000 renders and more than 300 animations! But we're not done yet, there's still quite a bit of work to do.

Exciting news! We're about to release a demo in Spanish and Polish, but we need to give it a thorough test first. Other languages are on the way too, and we'll keep you updated in future posts!

As promised, we're introducing the characters, starting with this post. Meet our beautiful latina - Veronica. Jake met her while working at the University. She's sweet, helpful, and innocent, but also has a jealous streak! She's a wonderful, mature woman who values stability. Does Jake want that stability too, or is he after something else right now? That's for you, the players, to decide.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: New UI and Italian language in Race of Life Demo!
notes.notes:
Great news for all Italian-speaking gamers! [b]You can now officially play Race of Life in Italian! [/b]Episode 1 along with the Extra scene is already available to play for free in the demo version! 

Additionally, for all players - we present a new UI - a completely new look for the game menu! We are still working on adding more languages, and we hope to include several more before the official release, allowing even more people to play and have fun with our game.

notes.title: Race of Life Demo is live!
notes.notes:
Race of Life Act 1 Demo is now live on Steam! It contains a good couple of hours of gameplay if you're a slow reader so it's a good sneak peek of what to expect from Race of Life in the future.

Have fun playing!

notes.title: First Dev Log
notes.notes:
Welcome to the new year and to our first development update on the Steam! 

Work on Act I is ongoing, and we're currently finalizing things to release a free demo for you this month here on Steam! 

From now on, we'll strive to post such updates so that you can truly see what Race of Life is all about, get to know the characters, and familiarize yourself with the story that awaits you after purchasing our game. In the next development update, we'll introduce to you the first love interest with whom you'll have plenty of interactions.

We hope you'll enjoy this way of immersing yourselves in the world of Race of Life!
